claims.text: The Inn at Little Washington was founded in 1978 in a former garage in a small Virginia town.

findings.quote: The Inn at Little Washington, once a humble garage in a tiny Virginia town, has transformed into a world-renowned culinary destination since its founding in 1978.

claims.text: Many hiking trails near the Inn can be reached in Shenandoah National Park via Skyline Drive.

findings.quote: Most can be easily found in the Shenandoah Park by accessing Skyline Drive.

claims.text: The Inn is in the heart of Virginia's wine country, surrounded by vineyards and wineries.

findings.quote: Nestled in the heart of Virginia's wine country, The Inn at Little Washington is surrounded by a tapestry of esteemed vineyards and wineries

claims.text: The guest rooms and suites were created by Joyce Evans, a London stage and set designer.

findings.quote: The Inn’s twenty-four guest rooms and suites are sumptuous hideaways created by Joyce Evans, a London stage and set designer

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler says the Inn has rooms and two-story suites, many with balconies and garden views.

findings.quote: both feature rooms and two-story suites, many with balconies and garden views

claims.text: Guests can stay in village cottages meant to give the feeling of being residents of the village past.

findings.quote: Spending time in these cottages gives our visitors the feeling of being residents of the village past.

claims.text: The grounds include a walled garden with a fountain and a pavilion overlooking the mountains, where guests can enjoy breakfast.

findings.quote: A delightful walled garden with a burbling fountain or a serene pavilion overlooking the mountains are inviting places for “temporary residents” to enjoy breakfast

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler describes the Monkey Room, where paintings of monkeys line the walls while guests sip cocktails.

findings.quote: head to the Monkey Room, where paintings of the primates tease from the walls while you sip a cocktail

claims.text: Guests can dine in the main Dining Room one evening and at the more casual Patty O's Cafe the next.

findings.quote: savor Michelin-starred meals in the main dining room one evening, then relax with a casual dinner at Patty O’s Café the next

claims.text: Master of Scotch Jeff LaBelle leads intimate Scotch tastings exploring rare bottles.

findings.quote: An intimate Scotch tasting led by Master of Scotch Jeff LaBelle, exploring rare bottles, distillery traditions, and the craft behind every remarkable dram.

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler reports that doormen greet guests by name at the entry.

findings.quote: Doormen greet you by name at the entry.

claims.text: In the Goose Walk, Farmer Andy leads a parade of American Buff geese down Middle Street while playing a soprano saxophone.

findings.quote: Farmer Andy leads a parade of American Buff geese down Middle Street serenaded by his soprano saxophone.

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler says the property spans 24 acres with mountain views, trails, a farm and a chicken coop with a crystal chandelier.

findings.quote: It spans 24 acres and is accented by mountain views, trails, a farm—even a chicken coop with a crystal chandelier.

claims.text: The Inn has a Grecian-inspired pool with private cabanas and poolside food from Patty O's Cafe.

findings.quote: Unwind in effortless luxury at our Grecian-inspired pool, where private cabanas, attentive service, and poolside delights from Patty O’s Café

claims.text: A golf cart tour shows guests the landscape that surrounds the Inn.

findings.quote: This intimate golf cart tour reveals the beauty, stories, and thoughtful care woven into the living landscape that surrounds the Inn.

claims.text: The farm micro safari runs Wednesday through Sunday, weather permitting.

findings.quote: Join Sharron Wednesday–Sunday at 4:45 PM (weather permitting) for what we like to call a micro safari right here at The Inn.
